entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0072 (Populate switch) reports a false positive on an exhaustive switch over a `closed` class hierarchy #86447
  • [BUG] Nested static class in Razor @code block breaks component inheritance discovery in .NET 11 (Regression) #86444
  • Razor formatting indents a line inside a C# block in a script one level deeper on every run when ignoring complex script indentation is off #86441
  • Razor dotnet format moves a block lambda body right on every run when the attribute is on a continuation line of the start tag #86440
  • Razor formatting changes the contents of a pre or textarea whose start tag isn't first on its line #86439
  • Razor formatting in Visual Studio ignores the Indent size in Tools > Options and indents by the Tab size #86431
  • Razor dotnet format indents a script or style body inside @if one level deeper on every run #86429
  • Razor formatting moves a block lambda body in an attribute right on every format when the lambda starts on the tag's line #86427
  • Unexpected type inference failure when async lambda is involved #86423
    Backlog

Closed

  • Memory-safety V2 crashes the compiler on a nullable generic override return type #86386
    18.14
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/main` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #86419
  • Razor formatting moves a continued lambda in a directive attribute to the tag's indentation #86306
    Backlog
  • Razor formatting (dotnet format) indents markup by tab_width and ignores indent_size #86303
    Backlog
  • Razor formatting miscounts nesting after a Razor comment and a closing tag on one line #86304
    Backlog
  • Compiler hangs when a parameter default value uses the natural type of its own method group #86348
    18.14

Created

  • Fix Razor component discovery when a base component falls back #86451
    Area-Razor

    Community
  • Handle syntax wrappers in address-of data flow analysis #86446
    Area-Compilers

    Area-Compilers, Test-Gap
  • Leave the contents of a Razor pre or textarea alone when its start tag isn't first on its line #86443
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Stop counting a C# block in a script or style body twice when formatting Razor #86442
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Keep script and style bodies inside C# blocks in place when formatting Razor with dotnet format #86438
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Give a multiline C# attribute value an expression context when formatting #86437
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Indent Razor elements whose start tag isn't first on its line #86436
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Use Visual Studio's Tools > Options indent size when formatting Razor #86435
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Keep a block lambda body in an attribute with its tag when formatting Razor #86434
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Support multithreaded ProjectData slice writes #86433
  • Format a multiline C# attribute value with a Razor transition as one expression #86432
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Don't close an element twice when its end tag is split across lines in a Razor code block #86430
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Add Razor formatting tests for script and style end tags that share a body line #86428
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Razor alias compiler #86426
    Area-Razor

  • Fix hang when a parameter default value uses the natural type of its own method group #86367
